title: Weapon Enchantment
body:
Syntax: weapon enchantment <weapon> <flaming|frost|life|sharp|vorpal|shocking>

Description: Permanently binds one property to a carried or wielded weapon: flaming, frost, life, sharp, vorpal, or shocking. Disenchant before changing the property. Bukijutsu unlocks at level 55. Costs 60 Chakra and 20 Stamina; 10 second cooldown.

Date: 2026-09-27
